name: Swannanoa Valley Christian Ministry
addr: 101 N Ridgeway Ave, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Salyna Morgan who's a volunteer there had some really mean things to say about George Floyd as well as the people who lost thoer lives in Minnesota in a Facebook post. I do undertand that everyone is entitled to their own opinions and thats fine but as a person who volunteers at a church thats very unacceptable. No matter the circumstances nobody deserves to be killed. And God loves all. Would the feelings be mutual if it was a family member of hers???? VERY DISTURBING
There the sweetest people in they world they help people every day God bless them and thank all of them for there services. Yall are the best always helping the community amen

This place is a great resource in a time of need. Food pantry, clothing, a few linens and kitchen items. My favorite thing they have right now is a gift card to use at the Laundromat that you can bring back in any time and they will reload funds onto it!
Dropped off a donation. Go around back and place on shelves near back door. Round the clock video monitors for security. Tough times for so many people. SVCM helps a lot. But

They are very helpful to people in the community. When my ex-husband and I split up, I was able to go up there and get help for christmas for my child. Also, I have had help with paying a power bill or a water bill in the past. Very ,nice, friendly staff.

This organization and the folks who volunteer with them and serve the public are really helpful and kind. We came home with so many good grocery items and winter clothing for the kids. Thankful for their help and services every 3 weeks. You have to get there before 2:30pm to get services and if going for the first time it's best to get there earlier in the morning. It doesn't take long to process paperwork, but lots of folks show up in the late morning. After your first time getting signed up you dont have to go inside anymore. You call ahead and they package everything you need and you drive up to recieve it without even having to go inside. If you need clothing items then they provide 30 mins to peruse and choose from their amazing selection of well organized and nice clothing inside. We also got help with wood for the winter!

Being a solo mom , to 2 small kids, during a global pandemic was the hardest thing I've ever done. But Christian ministries was a light in the dark. It's hard asking for help but with the kind staff it was much easier. When you feel so alone it's just nice to be reminded you have a town who cares. Thank you for all you do for our community ❤

This is a fine place to go for most any kind of help...food, clothing, household items. The staff as well as the many volunteers will make you feel welcome, no matter what your needs are, or how you got to a place in your life where you needed to ask for assistance Also remember the Ministries with items that you want to donate

We are very blessed having this organization available to us. The people who work there are volunteers and work hard to help each individual and family. Without this help we would have problems that could possibly leave us without . God Bless the ministry and workers and everyone who donates. Caring, caring and caring is what they are about. Roberta Turner

They got me kerosene for my only source of heat a monitor heater last year 2018 when I was total out and freezing !! They are true blessings to me !! I’m so thankful for people and places with all this love & caring for the well being of others !! Thank you very much !! ♥️🙏🏻 …
